launchFileSetupInstructions: Open Documents\Euro Truck Simulator 2\config.cfg and set uset g_console "1". Launch the normal Euro Truck Simulator 2 game, load your profile and map, press ~ to open the console, and run export_server_packages. Close the game, then click Start in Synix again. Synix will import the generated files automatically.
warningMessage: Euro Truck Simulator 2 must export its map, DLC, and mod package files from the normal game before the dedicated server can start. Follow the displayed setup steps; Synix will import the generated files into this server.
